description: Calculate both Wien peaks, Planck peak spectral radiances and Stefan-Boltzmann radiant exitance for an ideal blackbody from 1 K to 100000 K. Numerically integrates the fraction of total power in a wavelength band, default 380-760 nm, using shared CODATA 2018 constants.

band_max_nm.description: Upper wavelength in nm, greater than lower; default 760.

band_min_nm.description: Positive lower wavelength in nm; default 380.

name: blackbody_spectrum
title: Blackbody spectrum
